225:t_000:60.en:
$$ランカ$$
「Sorry for worrying you, $$アルト$$.」

225:t_000:61.en:
$$アルト$$
「Don't worry about it. We're friends, aren't we?」

225:t_001:0.en:
$$ラム$$
「Captain! We're getting a transmission from $$バトル７$$, outside the atmosphere! A swarm of $$バジュラ$$ is descending toward the ruins!」

225:t_001:1.en:
$$モニカ$$
「We've confirmed it on our end too! The swarm that broke through $$バトル７$$'s defense line is coming!」

225:t_002:1.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「That color...! They're the same as the ones from before!」

225:t_002:3.en:
$$シャア$$
「Save the speculation for later! They're about to attack!」

225:t_003:0.en:
$$ロラン$$
「It seems the $$バジュラ$$ are after the ruins!」

225:t_003:1.en:
$$クラン$$
「What's going on?! What on earth for?!」

225:t_003:2.en:
$$オズマ$$
「$$アルト$$, $$ガムリン$$, $n! Leave this to us and head for the ruins!」

225:t_003:3.en:
$$オズマ$$
「Gather all the information you can before they destroy the ruins!」

225:t_004:0.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「All units, intercept the $$バジュラ$$. Don't let them near the ruins.」

225:t_004:1.en:
$$キャシー$$
「To all units! The defense line will be set up like this!」

225:t_005:0.en:
$$アレルヤ$$
「If they get past that line, we'll be allowing a direct attack on the ruins, won't we?」

225:t_005:1.en:
$$グラハム$$
「Then all we have to do is strike them before that.」

225:t_005:2.en:
$$刹那$$
「With $$熱気バサラ$$ gone, is fighting all we can do now...」

225:t_005:4.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「All units, begin the attack! Hold out until the survey team returns!」

225:t_005:5.en:
$$オズマ$$
(I'm counting on you to look after $$ランカ$$, $$アルト$$, $$ブレラ$$...!)

225:t_006:0.en:
$$ナイジェル$$
「Tch! They're firing away like crazy!」

225:t_006:1.en:
$$コンロイ$$
「Those ruins... do they mean something to the $$バジュラ$$ too...?!」

225:t_008:0.en:
$$バナージ$$
「They're close to the ruins!」

225:t_009:0.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Are you all right, $$アルト$$?!」

225:t_009:2.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「This is $$ガムリン・木崎$$! $$バサラ$$ was injured by a collapsing wall! Prepare to take him in at once!」

225:t_009:3.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「I'm sorry, $$バサラ$$... You got hurt protecting me...」

225:t_009:4.en:
$$バサラ$$
「Don't... sweat it... More importantly... I'm gonna sing...」

225:t_009:6.en:
$$アルト$$
「What are you saying?! Get back, $$バサラ$$, now!」

225:t_009:7.en:
$$バサラ$$
「Shut up! I said... I'm gonna sing!」

225:t_010:0.en:
$$アルト$$
「That guy...! He's going to sing to the $$バジュラ$$...?!」

225:t_010:1.en:
$$ランカ$$
「$$アルト$$! I... I'm going to sing...!」

225:t_010:3.en:
$$ランカ$$
「I was born to do something too...! I'm here to get something across...! So...!」

225:t_013:0.en:
$$アマタ$$
「The $$バジュラ$$ are pulling back...」

225:t_013:1.en:
$$カイエン$$
「Is it the power of her song...?」

225:t_013:2.en:
$$ミコノ$$
「But it feels different from before...」

225:t_013:3.en:
$$ミコノ$$
「I can feel a gentler emotion...」

225:t_013:4.en:
$$シュレード$$
(Did $$ミコノ$$'s power to connect sense something flowing through $$ランカ$$'s song...?)

225:t_013:7.en:
$$ランカ$$
(What is this...? There's still sadness and doubt somewhere in my heart, but little by little, it's fading away...)

225:t_013:8.en:
$$ランカ$$
(If I keep on singing, surely someday...)

225:t_013:11.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「You... what about your body...?!」

225:t_013:12.en:
$$バサラ$$
「It hurts a little, but it's a lot easier than a minute ago.」

225:t_013:13.en:
$$レイ#pt231$$
「Is it because of $$ランカ$$'s song...」

225:t_013:15.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「Watch out! Something else is coming!」

225:t_014:1.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「The type the $$ギャラクシー船団$$ used!」

225:t_014:2.en:
$$ルカ$$
「Now that you mention it, during the $$時獄戦役$$, when $$アルテア$$'s $$ミカゲ$$ summoned the $$バジュラ$$, he called in $$ゴーストＶ９$$s along with them...!」

225:t_014:3.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「Then the $$ギャラクシー船団$$ is with the $$バジュラ$$?!」

225:t_014:4.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「All units, shoot down the Ghosts and gather all the information you can!」

225:t_014:5.en:
$$アルト$$
「$$ランカ$$! Leave the rest to us!」

225:t_015:0.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「If the enemy's a machine, I'll be your opponent! $$バサラ$$, you fall back!」

225:t_015:2.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「$$惑星ラクス$$ is a place of memories for me too. Since I'm on a planet like it, it's only natural.」

225:t_015:4.en:
$$バサラ$$
「Let's go! From here on, it's my stage!」

225:t_016:1.en:
$$ラム$$
「Also, $$バトル７$$ appears to still be in combat.」

225:t_016:2.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Depending on the situation, we'll go to their aid as well. Give all units the order to return.」

225:t_016:4.en:
$$アムロ$$
「$$アルト$$... The $$プロトカルチャー$$ ruins...」

225:t_016:5.en:
$$アルト$$
「Unfortunately the ruins were destroyed, but we did obtain some information about the end of the universe.」
